options.content:
Ethernet area home. Two independent live sources: the switch-side reachability sweep (switch_*{kind="eth_switch"}, 332 switches, job switch-fw) shown below, and the tray host NIC counters (node_network_* from 1,898 GB300 trays) shown on the four boards linked here.
Ethernet boards: Link state & throughput  ·  Link flaps  ·  L2 link errors  ·  Packet drops  ·  Congestion signalling  ·  Queueing delay  ·  Optical DOM  ·  Cross-plane detail

panels.description: REWIRED. Was max(lldpq_eth_effective_ber) — that family has zero series in VictoriaMetrics and never had any (BER export was never wired, it is not a collection outage). Replaced with lldpq_eth_symbol_errors_total, the real PHY-error signal that does exist: 14 links carrying 124 symbol errors total.
panels.title: Links w/ Symbol Errors

panels.description: REWIRED. Was PFC pause frames — cumulus_nvswitch_interface_dot3_in_pause_frames / _out_pause_frames have zero series in VictoriaMetrics and never did (pause-frame counters were never exported). Replaced with cumulus_nvswitch_interface_ether_stats_crc_align_errors, which is populated: 17 links with CRC/align errors.
panels.title: Links w/ CRC / FCS Errors

panels.description: cumulus_nvswitch_interface_performance_marked_packets, 14648 series, 1h rate window. Currently 0/s — no ECN congestion marking observed.

panels.description: REWIRED. Was count(lldpq_eth_optical_rx_power_dbm < -9) — the optical Rx/Tx power families have zero series in VictoriaMetrics and never did. Replaced with lldpq_eth_optical_temperature_celsius, the one DOM field that is actually collected: 237 of 917 modules at or above 60 C, hottest 69.3 C.
